{"task": {"id": "I_kwDONElfw88AAAABbjYpsA", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlV6PzhFHUPQ", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlV6P", "number": 110, "title": "Prepare @takahirox/three-mmd 0.1.3 for maintainer-only npm publish", "body": "## Problem

The maintainer wants to release **`@takahirox/three-mmd@0.1.3`** and explicitly wants all repository preparation completed and merged **before personally running the final `npm publish` command**.

Current `main` is `a05444db048c7329a56e34501193f0fe1845aa59` (PR #107); `package.json` and `package-lock.json` still declare **0.1.2**. The previous [0.1.2 release-preparation issue #104](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/issues/104) was completed through PR #105. Since then:

- **Library change:** [PR #107 / Issue #106](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/pull/107) normalizes PMD/PMX base/sphere/custom-toon resource paths before loading and caching, handles encoded and unsafe paths, and adds resource-path regression coverage. This fix is in `main` but was merged after 0.1.2's preparation.
- **Documentation-only:** [PR #109 / Issue #108](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/pull/109) documents test/CI performance principles; do not misrepresent it as a shipped runtime feature.

**Version reservation is not proven by repository metadata.** An attempt to open official npm registry version metadata during filing was inaccessible, so **verify `registry.npmjs.org` online afresh** with cache bypass before selecting/confirming `0.1.3`. If already published, stop and report the conflict rather than silently changing the maintainer's requested version.

## Expected outcome

Merge a fully tested, correctly versioned **0.1.3 release candidate** into `main`, with release metadata, documentation, distributable package and verification evidence ready. From an updated clean checkout with installed dependencies and npm authorization, the maintainer should need **no source edits or extra preparation**, only:

```sh
npm publish
```

**Strict boundary: no real npm publication by the agent or CI.** No npm login, credentials, secrets, automatic publishing, actual `npm publish`, release tag or GitHub release creation. Only `npm publish --dry-run --access public` is permitted. The user's manual publication is not a pre-merge or issue-completion condition.

### Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] Verify the **official npm registry** versions/dist-tags and exact `0.1.2` and `0.1.3` publication states with fresh online/cache-bypassed checks. Record HTTP responses and timestamps, distinguishing network failure from a confirmed unused version. **Use exactly 0.1.3 if available**; if unavailable, document the blocker and request a separate version decision instead of overwriting a published version or using `--force`.
- [ ] Update `package.json`, the lockfile's top-level version and lockfile root-package version consistently to `0.1.3`. Preserve the package name `@takahirox/three-mmd`, `publishConfig` public npm registry/access, versioned export paths, `three@~0.186.0` peer and `mmd-parser ^1.1.4` runtime dependency unless verified changes are necessary.
- [ ] Update `README.md`, `docs/releases.md`, create `docs/releases/0.1.3.md` and any other release-facing text that incorrectly names 0.1.2 as the next candidate. Record the actual published baseline, exact release-candidate source SHA / eventual merge SHA, and a concise **since-0.1.2** changelog highlighting PR #107's texture-resource path fix and its behavior/security bounds. Distinguish PR #109 documentation-only work. Retain accurate package contract, external Ammo initialization, pinned optional Bullet WASM and classic Worker instructions, existing known limitations, and do not claim MMD pixel equivalence or fully resolved rare PMD physics instability.
- [ ] Build the exact release artifact and check `npm pack --dry-run --json`: include the new `MMDResourcePath` runtime JS and any needed declaration/import references, all documented root/subpath exports, runtime JS/d.ts, classic Worker, optional Bullet JS/WASM/manifest/licenses and third-party notices. Confirm no unintended models, examples, fixture assets, development artifacts, credentials or local files are included. Verify source/resource hashes and license obligations.
- [ ] Verify **isolated installed-tarball JS/ESM and strict TypeScript consumers** from the candidate tarball without source aliases or pulling a published older version. Cover actual packaged texture-path normalization and cached canonical URLs where relevant; exercise packaged Bullet WASM and Worker startup using established tests.
- [ ] Run relevant automated validation on the final release tree: `npm ci`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run test:legacy`, `npm run test:browser`, `npm run build`, applicable source/built Examples tests and fixture build, `npm pack --dry-run --json`, `npm publish --dry-run --access public` and `git diff --check`. Keep `prepack` and `prepublishOnly` safeguards active; demonstrate that no real upload occurs. Record successes, failures, skips and evidence honestly. Apply repository's test/CI performance guidance without silently removing important release gates.
- [ ] Give the maintainer a **short final handoff**: confirmed version and registry availability, final merge SHA, local checks / CI links, any non-blocking limitations and external prerequisites (npm login, publishing rights, 2FA/token as applicable). The final command must be the unmodified **`npm publish`** from a clean, up-to-date `main`; it is **for the maintainer only**. Do not invent authentication or assert that the registry upload already happened.
- [ ] Keep implementation scope to release preparation, fixing a demonstrated packaging defect only if needed. Do not bundle unrelated shader, IK, physics or demo visual changes; no subjective visual-approval gate.

### Required post-merge verification

- **PENDING until performed:** Inspect the latest **merge-triggered Tests and Deploy browser examples** workflow attempts for the exact release-prep merge SHA, record run URLs/statuses/results. The latest PR-branch run cannot stand in for the merge run.
- **PENDING until performed:** Check that GitHub Pages publishes the correct merge SHA and its served Examples/JS/WASM assets, and verify basic PMD/PMX/Worker startup as applicable. Pages deployment **is not npm publication**.
- **Outside scope, maintainer-only:** npm login and real `npm publish`, optionally followed by checking the new official registry version. The release-preparation issue can be closed before the maintainer publishes.

## Context

- Current source: [`main` at `a05444db048c7329a56e34501193f0fe1845aa59`](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/commit/a05444db048c7329a56e34501193f0fe1845aa59).
- [0.1.2 release preparation #104](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/issues/104), [PR #105](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/pull/105), [release guide](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/docs/releases.md).
- [Path fix #106 / PR #107](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/pull/107); [texture resource path notes](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/docs/texture-resource-paths.md); [CI guidance #108 / PR #109](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/pull/109).
- The maintainer **will personally run `npm publish`** after release preparation is complete.
